summary: UP Fintech Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its subsidiaries received administrative penalties from the CSRC Beijing Bureau for unlicensed cross-border securities, fund, and futures business in mainland China. Penalties total approximately RMB308.1 million, with confiscation of illegal income of ~RMB103.1 million; CEO Tianhua Wu received a RMB1.25 million warning and penalty. Retail client assets in mainland China represent ~10% of total client assets as of end-2025. The company accepts the penalty and is cooperating with regulators. This is a regulatory compliance disclosure, not a special situation transaction.
